scopeNote: integration contract: Pure-Swift client (PyricCrashlytics) conforming to FirebaseCrashlytics via the Pyric WebSocket bridge and CrashlyticsBroker. Covers per-app Crashlytics.crashlytics singletons and multi-app isolation, setCrashlyticsCollectionEnabled overrides, plain and formatted log breadcrumbs, setUserID and setCustomValue / setCustomKeysAndValues with nil key removal, NSError underlying-cause and ExceptionModel / StackFrame recording, checkForUnsentReports and checkAndUpdateUnsentReports post-crash annotation, flush and getState inspection, and RS256 App Check token attachment.
